# Organization — Settings
{: .no_toc }

Rename, leave, set up SCIM provisioning, or (staff) suspend the organization.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ORG-08` |
| **Route** | `/orgs/:orgId/settings` · deep link `substratal://orgs/:orgId/settings` |
| **Where** | Personal › Organizations |
| **Who can use it** | org_admin (rename, SCIM), organizations.manage (suspend, SCIM), any member (leave) |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwPreferencesPage` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | text-field | Organization.name |  | AdwEntryRow |
| Leave organization | destructive-row | DELETE …/members/me |  | AdwButtonRow .destructive-action |
| SCIM provisioning | section | GET …/scim-token → `created_at`, `created_by`, `last_used_at`, `base_url` | org_admin or organizations.manage; behind `scim` flag; 404 scim_token_not_found = "Not set up" | AdwPreferencesGroup |
| Set up / Rotate token | button | POST …/scim-token → token + base_url | rotate confirms first ("Your identity provider stops syncing until you paste the new token"); secret shown once (KEY-03 pattern) | AdwButtonRow |
| Turn off SCIM | destructive-row | DELETE …/scim-token | confirm; members already provisioned stay | AdwButtonRow .destructive-action |
| Suspend / Reactivate | destructive-row | PATCH {status, reason} | staff only; reason required | AdwButtonRow .destructive-action |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Rename | `PATCH /organizations/{id} {name}` |  |
| Leave | `DELETE /organizations/{id}/members/me` | 409 last admin |
| Load SCIM status | `GET /organizations/{id}/scim-token` | 404 scim_token_not_found → "Not set up" with a Set up button |
| Create / rotate SCIM token | `POST /organizations/{id}/scim-token` | 201 → one-time secret sheet showing `base_url` and `token` with Copy; the previous token stops working at once |
| Turn off SCIM | `DELETE /organizations/{id}/scim-token` | 204 → "Not set up" |

## Good to know

- SCIM provisioning *invites* people (they join when they accept, via ORG-09) and deprovisioning removes the membership, never the account. Provisioned members show in ORG-03 like any invitation. SCIM itself (`/scim/v2`) is called by the identity provider, never by the Hub.
